_about: Water (1) + acetic acid (2) + ethyl acetate (3): liquid-liquid tie lines at 293.2 and 313.2 K and 95 kPa, from Roque et al. (2018). Phase I is the water-rich liquid, phase II the ester-rich liquid. Rows: T in K, the mole fractions of water, acetic acid and ethyl acetate in phase I, the same in phase II, and the combined expanded uncertainty the record states for acetic acid in phase I and in phase II.

source.citation: L. R. Roque, R. R. Pinto, L. H. de Oliveira, S. C. Rabelo, Liquid-liquid equilibrium data for ternary systems of water + acetic acid + acetate esters at 293.2 K and 303.2 K and ~ 95 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 463 (2018) 34-47
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 18 (water + acetic acid + ethyl acetate, phases liquid mixture 2 and 1, 12 rows): v1 T; v2 mole fraction of water in liquid 2; p1 acetic acid in liquid 2; p2 acetic acid in liquid 1; p3 water in liquid 1. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: The mole fraction of ethyl acetate in each liquid is 1 minus the other two (not stored in the record), rounded to the record's 4 decimals. The title says 293.2 K and 303.2 K; the record stores the second isotherm at 313.2 K, and the value of the record is kept here: a person should check it in the article. u_I and u_II are the record's uncertainties of acetic acid in liquid 2 (water-rich) and liquid 1 (ester-rich); they are 0.012-0.016, larger than the record's other ternary sets.
